def forward(groups):
    day, month, year, hour, minute, second, sp, offset = groups
    text = day + '/' + month + '/' + year + ' ' + hour + ':' + minute + ':' + second + ' ' + offset
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%d/%b/%Y %H:%M:%S %z')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp_len = layout[0]
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000, tz=datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=int(record['stored'][0] % 10000 / 100))))
    day = dt.strftime('%d')
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    year = dt.strftime('%Y')
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    offset = dt.strftime('%z')
    return '[' + day + '/' + month + '/' + year + ':' + time + ' ' + (' ' * sp_len) + offset + ']'
